notes: v1.54: No more runaway cmd windows during failed updates. Batch now hidden (CREATE_NO_WINDOW), runs silently. Single-instance lock prevents stacking multiple update batches on top of each other. Retries cut 60→20 (40s max) so a doomed update gives up faster instead of looping for 2 minutes. Startup orphan sweep also cleans stale _qyt_update.bat and _qyt_update.lock.
